title: Azure Virtual Machine Scale Sets - Simply Explained
description:
Learn how Azure Virtual Machine Scale Sets enable horizontal scaling, autoscale rules, and high availability for your cloud applications.

Imagine your website suddenly gets ten times more visitors, but only one virtual machine handles every request. Pages slow down, people wait, and some may leave before your app even responds.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • Opening: Why One Virtual Machine Isn’t Enough
  • The Problem: A Single VM Has a Fixed Limit
  • What a Virtual Machine Scale Set Actually Is
  • How Requests Reach Healthy Instances
  • Autoscale: Adding and Removing VM Instances
  • Uniform and Flexible: Choosing the Management Model
  • Keeping the Fleet Healthy During Failures and Updates
  • When to Use a Scale Set
  • Conclusion: Next Knowledge Nugget

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.
